sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 9:10

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 9:10:1
items.html:
The Achoraim [posterior] of this name, which is AB [72] KADEM [144] in Gematria, etc., and the two of them together are RIU [216] in Gematria, Gevura — this is the discernment of the Kli. But the name in its order, in its filling, etc., these are the MAN themselves: You must know what the ARI wrote in Etz Chaim, Gate 18, at the end of Chapter 1, and these are his words: “The root of HaVaYaH is the four letters themselves, but their filling is the explanation of HaVaYaH and the going out of their lights outward.” Meaning, the four letters of HaVaYaH without a filling indicate the ten root Sefirot in the Partzuf, which are called Rosh [head] or Keter; and when they have a filling, they explain the root — that is, they explain the measure of the stature of the Partzuf — namely, according to the four fillings: AB [72], SAG [63], MA [45] and BON [52], as is known. He further wrote there that the name HaVaYaH in its square indicates the discernment of the posterior of the Partzuf.
And this is what he says, “And all these discernments are all in the name BON,” namely, as above, that all the discernments of the MAN of all the five Partzufim of Nekudim are called by the name HaVaYaH of BON. “The Achoraim [posterior] of this name, which in Gematria is AB [72] KADEM [144] — AB [72] plainly, and KADEM [144] in its filling,” for the posterior of the simple HaVaYaH, without a filling, is AB [72], and the posterior of HaVaYaH with the filling of BON is KADEM [144]. “And the two of them together are RIU [216] in Gematria, Gevura — this is the discernment of the Kli. But the name in its order, in its filling, is BON [52] in Gematria — these are the MAN themselves.”
And you see how the ARI is precise in explaining to us well the difference between the MAN themselves and the vessel that raises the MAN. For the two discernments — the posterior of the upper one and the face of the lower one — that are in every MAN are hinted at in the posterior of HaVaYaH of BON, which is the discernment of the upper one, and in the face of HaVaYaH of BON, which are the anterior vessels of the GE [Galgalta ve Einayim] of the lower one. Therefore, the discernment of the posterior, which is the RIU included in the MAN, from which is made the completion of the posterior of the Gadlut of the upper one, and which joins to the building of the Partzuf of the upper one — it becomes the discernment of the vessel that raises the MAN of the lower one to it, to correct it in its coupling, as above in the explanation of the firstborn sons of AVI with respect to ZON. For in like manner, here too, in the Nukva: after her Katnut is already complete, she raises her MAN to the coupling of ZON; and these MAN are included also of two discernments — of the posterior of herself, which fell to BYA, and of the discernment of the face of the souls of the righteous, namely, the discernments of the RIU in the MAN, together with the anterior vessels of the souls of the righteous, which are the discernment of HaVaYaH of BON in its order, since they are anterior vessels and not posterior. And at the time that they were corrected by the coupling of ZON the first time, the correction rises only to the discernment of the posterior of the Nukva alone, namely, to the discernment of the RIU of the MAN; but to the discernment of HaVaYaH of BON of the MAN, which are the anterior vessels of the souls of the righteous, no correction reaches them as yet, although they clothe the posterior of the Nukva at the time of the coupling, as above.
And this is what he says, “A woman does not conceive from the first intercourse,” for the first intercourse suffices only to raise the AHP of the Nukva, to complete her building in the ten Sefirot of Gadlut, that is, her posterior; but the anterior vessels of the souls of the righteous, which are found with her AHP at the time of the coupling, are not depicted at all now, as above. Rather, afterwards — after her posterior has already received all its correction — a second coupling is made in her upon these MAN of the souls of the righteous, and then she conceives from them.
And this is what he says, “For in the first intercourse he made in her the discernment of a vessel, and from then on there is a place for the MAN to be depicted within it, and then she conceives,” for before her own AHP are corrected, how could she correct the MAN of the souls of the righteous, who are a lower degree than her, and who are unfit to receive from ZA alone, since he is like an upper one above them? Therefore the MAN cannot be depicted in her at the first intercourse; only in the second intercourse, when her AHP are already corrected within the building of her Partzuf, are the MAN depicted within the vessel of her posterior, and there they receive their portion. And we have already expanded on this matter with respect to the MAN of AVI (above, page 739, the passage beginning “And this is what he says, ‘But’”). And compare the three degrees here with the three degrees there — AA, AVI and ZON — in the whole order: for ZA is similar to AA, and the Nukva to AVI, that is, to the upper one; and the anterior vessels of the souls of the righteous are similar to ZON, who in the second coupling with the upper one nearest them receive the correction of their Katnut, called Ibur. And in this way you will understand the matters better. You will also see how this matter applies in all the kinds of MAN.
